protocol: One immutable Q8 model; four separately owned decoder/KV states. Prefix prefill then complete raw cache clone/readback plus descriptive cache-label clone. Quiet and captured serial and batch appends use the actual private decoder graph. Main-thread hook discovers 19 stages per layer by weight/cache identity, marks selected outputs before allocation, and copies all floats while the graph lives. Require exact full semantic graph metadata and callback identities within process, excluding custom2 C struct padding; capture must preserve quiet hidden and active KV bits. Compare valid causal rows of every stage, require masked future probabilities zero, preserve positions/prefix/inputs and all loaded model bytes. Eight known failing cases, twelve matched T1/T2 controls, six exact T4/T8 controls. Original96-case null-hook gate must reproduce V1 completely in each build. No math/production batch API/timing; stage attribution is distinct from candidate parity and corpus accuracy.
